title: Edit Diagram Elements
description: As a database designer, I want to move, resize, and delete tables and relationships on the canvas so that I can organize the diagram for readability.
acceptanceCriteria: Given elements exist on the canvas, when the user moves, resizes, or deletes an element, then the canvas updates accordingly and the model reflects the change

evidence: commit:a7f7944 STORY-008: implement move, resize, and delete for diagram elements (ticket/STORY-008, 7 files, +299/-23)

files: src/components/TableNode.tsx (drag-to-move via pointer events on header, resize handle bottom-right with MIN_TABLE_WIDTH=200/MIN_TABLE_HEIGHT=100, delete button in header, onDeleteTable prop), src/components/RelationshipLine.tsx (click-to-delete via onDelete prop with pointerEvents all), src/components/DiagramCanvas.tsx (onDeleteTable/onDeleteRelationship props passed to TableNode/RelationshipLine), src/App.tsx (removeTable/removeRelationship destructured from useDiagram, handleDeleteTable/handleDeleteRelationship callbacks wired to DiagramCanvas), src/index.css (grab/grabbing cursor on table header, resize-handle styles, delete-table button styles)

test-files: src/components/DiagramCanvas.test.tsx (added onDeleteTable/onDeleteRelationship props to all render calls), src/components/TableNode.test.tsx (added onDeleteTable={vi.fn()} to renderTableNode helper and all inline renders)
